da1_strata.definition: syllabus code x parse path (det|gemini) x tariff band (1|2|3+)
da1_strata.reconciles_with_census_leaves_txt: The ORIGINAL census-leaves.txt prints 'DA1 strata populated: 12' because census_leaves.py counted its own '0/unknown' catch-all as a band. DA1 defines three bands (1/2/3+), so the honest count is 9 populated of 18 defined. Do not cite the 12. As of the 2026-08-25 correction the catch-all is empty anyway (zero unbanded true leaves) and the fixed script excludes it explicitly -- census-leaves-corrected.txt prints 9.
da1_strata.empty_by_construction: the 9 gemini-path strata; production parse path is det-if-det-succeeded / gemini-if-det-failed, so a det-only corpus cannot populate them at any n
